snippet.title: Devastator Announce Trailer (PC/Xbox/Playstation/Switch)
snippet.description: Devastator is a retro-modern arcade twin-stick shooter coming to PC and consoles in 2021. Featuring spectacular, fluid visuals (with 4k and 120hz+ support), heart-pounding music and sound, and intuitive, intense, and varied gameplay, Devastator is the ultimate twin-stick shooter for people who love twin-stick shooters!
